classification_definitions.checked_no_known_issue: These two known checks found no issue; not general reading readiness, no-context resistance, model accuracy or training certification.
classification_definitions.known_question_only: Known singleton-codebook predictor exactly matches this row using question only; no claim every CF or task instance is solvable.
classification_definitions.needs_byte_hash_tool: At least one required patch SHA256 is absent literally from all three inspected reading surfaces; exact original diff bytes plus a hash implementation would be needed.
classification_definitions.not_assessed: Required fields or supported schema unavailable, or this narrow diagnostic could not inspect the row.

limitations: No original product, filter receipt, frozen audit, export, or release signature was changed.
Existing gate ok and file bindings were checked; HMAC signatures were not independently reverified.
Patch-digest absence is literal visibility only: this is not a proof of logical impossibility and does not verify byte recovery from rendered context.
The checker does not claim arbitrary cryptographic computation is a reasonable reading-only model target.
Singleton-codebook misses and not-applicable cases are not a general question-only model evaluation.
No dense retrieval, general shortcut search, cross-product near-dedup, train/eval leakage audit, or B5 sample alignment was rerun.
Rows, views and lengths are correlated and must not be counted as independent tasks or source worlds.

limits: Exact identifier comparison only, not a full content or semantic leakage audit.
Task-derived source-workflow IDs may differ across tasks on the same underlying source; repository and issuer CIK are separately compared when applicable.
Identifier absence is not inferred from nonoverlapping world IDs.
CIK is extracted only from structured issuer-ir filing/source record IDs in finance contexts; non-finance rows have no applicable CIK identity.
new_train_vs_existing_eval_source_identi.scope: P59/P60 new gate-qualified train rows compared with all existing eval rows in the selected inventory, using repository/CIK/real-source-workflow IDs rather than world IDs

wasmtime.note: The failed P59/P60 Wasmtime source/candidate attempts are not qualified products and are not inventoried. No Wasmtime repository identity appears in these new qualified train rows.
